consent.title: Parental Consent Required
consent.intro: Before proceeding with the assessment, please review and accept the following:
points: This assessment is for screening purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice
Your responses will be used to generate an initial assessment report
All data will be processed according to our privacy policy
You can stop the assessment at any time and your progress will be saved
Results should be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional
